brief.t: START HERE: Pull the Polo 4PL invoice for container EMCU8614105, verify payment status, and send Erik the receipt so clearance can begin.

ACT NOW 1: Clearance and release for container EMCU8614105 remain blocked because payment confirmation and the receipt are still unverified. Erik and 4PL Accounting are waiting; no stated deadline, and the blocker has remained open 3 calendar days since October 2. Send: Erik, I am confirming the invoice payment now and will send the receipt. Please confirm clearance and the pickup ETA once duties are paid.

ACT NOW 2: FSS order 162946 was paid and the supplier said it could be expedited today, October 5, but dispatch and tracking remain unverified. PLL is waiting on the raw material; 0 days overdue. Send: Phillip, please confirm today's expedited dispatch and send tracking.

ACT NOW 3: Kenna's Et-VC package forwarding remains unverified 19 calendar days after its reported September 16 delivery. Mel is waiting; no stated deadline. Send: Mel, I am locating the Et-VC package and will send the forwarding tracking and status today.

next: Recommendation: Resolve the Polo 4PL payment receipt first because the container cannot advance to clearance or release without it.

Scheduled: 3 email-derived milestones. The nearest is the signature-required HyloGlo HA delivery today between 10:30 AM and 2:30 PM; assign someone to receive PO-2026-0023. ActivePeptide ships October 6.
Noise: 12 exact-window Outlook items, none urgent.

Source gaps: CRM browser session signed out. WhatsApp Web signed out. Purchasing did not reply within 10 minutes. Email reported no substantive drafts; its only overdue commitment belongs to Sam, not Aidan.
signal: Polo 4PL container release, FSS raw-material dispatch, and Kenna package forwarding remain the clearest operational and revenue-protection signals.
redflags: Container EMCU8614105 cannot proceed to clearance and release until payment is confirmed and the receipt is sent.
FSS order 162946 reached its promised expedite date without verified dispatch or tracking.
CRM and WhatsApp were unavailable for this run.
noise: 14 unique inbound Outlook messages arrived in the exact window; 12 were noise. Eleven of the 14 were unread.
